title: Souls-like platformer game made for fun
author: DueResponse2717
selftext:
Hi everyone! Last month I shared a [demo](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1v0c1zg/a_bloodborne_castlevania_platformer_demo/) here for a Metroidvania platformer inspired by the atmosphere of Souls-like games, and got a lot of friendly, honest feedback. I've spent a few weekends since then expanding it:

* Redesigned player character actions
* A world tour through six areas of Chapter 1 (clinic, cathedral ward, burned village)
* A boss fight demo
* Early drafts of the map and UI
* An [itch.io](http://itch.io) [project page](https://rexzen.itch.io/bloodvania)

It's still early and not playable yet, so I put together a short trailer to give you a feel for the look and mood.

On AI-assisted development: I'm a software engineer who dabbles in music, with no background in art or game dev. Tools like Claude Code and PixelLab are what make it possible for one person to handle design, code, art, and music in their spare time. That said, AI still can't carry level design, art direction, or figuring out what actually makes gameplay fun — maybe aesthetics and storytelling are the part that stays human.

I know some communities have reservations about AI-assisted projects. For what it's worth, this is a non-commercial hobby project — nobody has been charged anything, and nobody ever will be. Designing and shipping a game solo is just intrinsically fun.

Honest impressions are very welcome!
